'''Jent Koush''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Koush was sympathetic to the plight of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], Kashyyyk's native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], so he altered manifest records to assist Wookiees that were escaping from the Imperials.
